name: Pine Club
description: It is a rough pine knot club with bark patches, pale wood grain, and a blunt hand-hewn head.

name: Oak Club
description: It is a heavy oak club with thick rings, dark knots, and a sturdy old-forest silhouette.

name: Ash Club
description: It is a slim ash club with pale grain, a straight shaft, and a clean primitive finish.

name: Cedar Club
description: It is a reddish cedar club with warm wood tones, bark remnants, and a rustic blunt shape.

name: Ebony Club
description: It is a dark ebony club with a severe polished black sheen and an ominous profile.

name: Worldroot Club
description: It is a twisted living-root club with tangled veins, sacred bark texture, and primal druidic form.

name: Crude Sharpened Stick
description: It is a rough branch spear with bark still attached, a chipped point, and primitive handling.

name: Oak Sharpened Stick
description: It is an oak branch weapon with a thick grain, sharpened tip, and sturdy woodland feel.

name: Ash Sharpened Stick
description: It is a pale pointed ash rod with a straight shaft, light build, and clean survival style.

name: Cedar Sharpened Stick
description: It is a warm red cedar shaft with a sharpened end, simple wraps, and rustic elegance.

name: Ebony Sharpened Stick
description: It is a dark pointed ebony rod with a sleek black finish and a sinister edge.

name: Worldroot Sharpened Stick
description: It is a root-twisted staff-spear with living fibers, natural knots, and sacred wild.

name: Apprentice's Dagger
description: It is a plain learner's dagger with a short steel blade, simple guard, and modest grip.

name: Duchess's Dagger
description: It is an elegant noble dagger with delicate filigree, polished metal, and courtly refinement.

name: Viscount's Dagger
description: It is a sleek aristocratic dagger with a narrow blade, tasteful ornament, and restrained prestige.

name: Marquess's Dagger
description: It is a finely crafted dagger with richer trim, balanced proportions, and noble authority.

name: Chancellor's Dagger
description: It is a formal state dagger with disciplined symmetry, sharp polish, and administrative gravitas.

name: Sovereign's Dagger
description: It is a regal dagger with ornate hilt, radiant metal, and the unmistakable air of royalty.

name: Apprentice's Sickle
description: It is a small training sickle with a simple crescent blade and humble farm-forged look.

name: Harvestmoon Sickle
description: It is a silver crescent sickle with moonlit curves, graceful balance, and harvest symbolism.

name: Wildroot Sickle
description: It is a natural sickle with vine-wrapped grip, greenwood accents, and druidic growth motifs.

name: Thornweave Sickle
description: It is a thorn-lined sickle with twisted brambles, sharp botanical details, and cruel elegance.

name: Lunarfang Sickle
description: It is a crescent blade shaped like a moon fang, cold silver, and predatory grace.

name: Eldermoon Sickle
description: It is an ancient moon sickle with weathered silver metal and a soft, wise lunar aura.

name: Blunt Spear
description: It is a plain spear with a dull metal point, straight shaft, and practical old-world utility.

name: Bloodrite Spear
description: It is a ritual spear with crimson accents, dark steel, and sacrificial ceremonial flair.

name: Skyfather's Spear
description: It is a sky-touched spear with pale blue steel, a noble point, and stormborn elegance.

name: Totemcaller Spear
description: It is a tribal spear with carved charms, feather ties, and ancestral spirit markings.

name: Wolfspirit Spear
description: It is a hunter's spear with fang motifs, fur wrappings, and a ghostly predatory aura.

name: Godsblood Spear
description: It is a divine blood spear with red-gold metal, sacred corruption, and mythic menace.

name: Uneven Crossbow
description: It is a rough-built crossbow with crooked limbs, plain wood, and the awkward charm of an early workshop's invention.

name: Arbalest Crossbow
description: It is a heavier arbalest with reinforced arms, disciplined construction, and the serious poise of siege-born engineering.

name: Deadeye Crossbow
description: It is a precise hunting crossbow with a taut frame, fine metal fittings, and the sharp stillness of a weapon made to strike true.

name: Siegebreaker Crossbow
description: It is a brutal crossbow of formidable strength, thick limbs, and a fortress-cracking silhouette.

name: Executioner's Crossbow
description: It is a grim, austere crossbow with severe lines and a cold, merciless presence fit for final judgment.

name: Doomsight Crossbow
description: It is a dreadful masterwork crossbow with dark metal accents, ominous symmetry, and the air of an omen made steel.

name: Rusty Short Sword
description: It is a weathered little blade of pitted iron, its chipped edge and stained hilt giving it the grim dignity of a survivor.

name: Soldier's Short Sword
description: It is a practical battlefield sidearm, cleanly forged and plain-faced, built for dependable service rather than glory.

name: Sergeant's Short Sword
description: It is a harder-used command blade with neat steel lines, modest brass trimming, and the disciplined look of veteran hands.

name: Captain's Short Sword
description: It is a refined officer's weapon with polished steel, balanced proportions, and a quiet air of authority.

name: Marshal's Short Sword
description: It is a formal, high-ranking sword of crisp craftsmanship and ceremonial severity, fit for a battlefield lord.

name: Peerless Short Sword
description: It is an exquisite duelist's blade of flawless temper and elegant form, sharp enough to suggest mastery before it ever strikes.

name: Rusty Sword
description: It is an old and corroded sword with scarred metal, a weary edge, and the melancholy beauty of forgotten wars.

name: Knight's Sword
description: It is a noble knightly blade with a straight gleaming edge, a proud guard, and the restrained grace of chivalric steel.

name: Baron's Sword
description: It is a lordly weapon with tasteful ornament, a rich polished finish, and the measured confidence of inherited power.

name: Duke's Sword
description: It is a stately blade of fine steel and elegant balance, marked by aristocratic refinement and old bloodline prestige.

name: Highlord's Sword
description: It is a grand, commanding sword with brilliant polish, regal symmetry, and the unmistakable presence of dominion.

name: Ascendant Sword
description: It is a transcendent blade of radiant craftsmanship, uplifted in design and aura, as if forged for the heights of legend.

name: Loose Mace
description: It is a simple iron mace with a plain round head, rough haft, and frontier weapon charm.

name: Vanguard's Mace
description: It is a disciplined military mace with reinforced head, bronze trim, and front-line authority.

name: Templar's Mace
description: It is an austere holy mace with cross-like geometry, clean steel, and temple-made precision.

name: Crusader's Mace
description: It is a battle-worn crusader mace with sharp flanges, polished edges, and righteous severity.

name: Zealot's Mace
description: It is an aggressive mace with jagged forms, dark metal, and fanatic ritual intensity.

name: Judgment Mace
description: It is a stern ceremonial mace with symmetrical lines, heavy weight, and verdict-like presence.

name: Blunt Battle Axe
description: It is a heavy battle axe with a dull, smashed-looking edge and a workman's brutality that favors force over finesse.

name: Drakebiter Battle Axe
description: It is a sharp, dragon-hunter's axe with a clean steel bite and a predatory, scalescarred look.

name: Scaleshredder Battle Axe
description: It is a savage axe with jagged steel contours, built to tear through hide, armor, and the pride of beasts.

name: Wyrmreaver Battle Axe
description: It is a fearsome war axe with a noble blade and a heroic profile, made for the downfall of great monsters.

name: Drakebane Battle Axe
description: It is a refined dragon-slaying axe with polished steel and a lethal, mythic edge.

name: Dragonbane Battle Axe
description: It is a legendary axe of mighty proportions, elegant yet cruel, with the unmistakable authority of a dragon-killing relic.

name: Bent Greatsword
description: It is a battered greatsword with a slightly warped blade, old scars, and the weary grandeur of a weapon that has endured too much war.

name: Direblade Greatsword
description: It is a long, predatory greatsword with a severe edge and a dark, menacing elegance.

name: Doomcleaver Greatsword
description: It is a heavy executioner's greatsword with broad steel, brutal balance, and the finality of a falling sentence.

name: Dawnbringer Greatsword
description: It is a luminous greatsword with bright polished steel and noble lines, as if forged to cut through night itself.

name: Soulrender Greatsword
description: It is a sinister yet beautiful greatsword with a haunting blade profile and a chilling, spirit-severing aura.

name: Godslayer Greatsword
description: It is an awe-inspiring greatsword of immense authority, radiant steel, and mythic presence, as if made to challenge heaven.

name: Apprentice's Warhammer
description: It is a modest training hammer with a small iron head and simple haft, earnest and humble in its blunt purpose.

name: Skullsplitter Warhammer
description: It is a vicious warhammer with a dense crushing head and an unforgiving silhouette made for smashing bone and helm alike.

name: Earthshaker Warhammer
description: It is a stout hammer with a weighty head and grounded design, as though every strike could rattle stone beneath it.

name: Thunderstrike Warhammer
description: It is a fierce hammer of clean metal and stormborn energy, carrying the suggestion of lightning in its form.

name: Stormbreaker Warhammer
description: It is a mighty warhammer with a commanding profile, built like a tool to shatter shields and break tempests.

name: Worldender Warhammer
description: It is a colossal-looking relic hammer with ancient gravitas, immense presence, and the terrible dignity of an ending made metal.

name: Apprentice's Bow
description: It is a simple learner's bow with a modest curve, plain wood, and the quiet promise of a first hunt.

name: Ranger's Bow
description: It is a practical wilderness bow with a clean arc, dark grip, and the balanced grace of a seasoned tracker.

name: Marksman's Bow
description: It is a finely tuned bow with elegant limbs, crisp craftsmanship, and the disciplined poise of a true shot-maker.

name: Sharpshooter's Bow
description: It is a sleek precision bow with a taut frame and refined finish, built for speed, accuracy, and deadly calm.

name: Elven Bow
description: It is a graceful bow of flowing lines and delicate craftsmanship, light as a whisper and touched by woodland artistry.

name: Windsong Bow
description: It is an airy, elegant bow with a sweeping curve and lyrical shape, as if the breeze itself had learned to hunt.

name: Tight Quiver
description: It is a compact leather quiver stitched with care, snugly fitted and travel-worn, made to ride close and silent.

name: Oak Quiver
description: It is a sturdy oak-bound quiver with warm wood tones, reinforced edges, and the dependable strength of forest craft.

name: Ash Quiver
description: It is a pale, swift-looking quiver with clean grain and a light hunter's profile, built for motion and precision.

name: Cedar Quiver
description: It is a richly colored quiver of reddish cedar, neat in form and warm in spirit, like something from old woodlands.

name: Ebony Quiver
description: It is a dark and polished quiver with a sleek black finish, understated yet severe, with a shadowed elegance.

name: Worldroot Quiver
description: It is a living, rootwoven quiver of tangled natural fibers and ancient growth, touched by druidic wild magic.

name: Crude Bolt Girdle
description: It is a rough bolt belt of coarse leather and blunt utility, all function and no finery.

name: Oak Bolt Girdle
description: It is a sturdy oak-fitted bolt girdle with firm stitching and a grounded, woodcrafted reliability.

name: Ash Bolt Girdle
description: It is a slim pale girdle with tidy loops and a light, disciplined form suited to a quick archer's kit.

name: Cedar Bolt Girdle
description: It is a warm-toned cedar girdle with careful bindings and a rustic, well-kept finish.

name: Ebony Bolt Girdle
description: It is a sleek dark girdle with polished leather and a stern, elegant silhouette.

name: Worldroot Bolt Girdle
description: It is a rootbound girdle of woven living fibers and ancient bark texture, as though grown rather than made.

name: Loose Magic Staff
description: It is a plain, wandering staff of straight wood and simple binding, humble in form yet quietly potent in spellwork.

name: Amethyst Magic Staff
description: It is a stately arcane staff topped with amethyst brilliance, its violet light lending it a contemplative mysticism.

name: Sapphire Magic Staff
description: It is a refined staff with a blue crystal focus and clean silver fittings, cool as moonlit scholarship.

name: Ruby Magic Staff
description: It is a powerful staff crowned in ruby fire, warm and regal, with the heartbeat of a contained blaze.

name: Mana Magic Staff
description: It is a finely tuned staff of balanced lines and luminous channels, built to guide pure magical force with elegance.

name: Astral Magic Staff
description: It is a majestic staff of celestial crystal and starry detailing, bearing the grand, distant splendor of the heavens.

name: Beginner's Wand
description: It is a simple apprentice's wand of plain carved wood, humble and earnest, bearing the quiet promise of first spells.

name: Amethyst Wand
description: It is a graceful wand crowned with violet crystal, rich with refined arcane beauty and a cool mystic glow.

name: Sapphire Wand
description: It is a polished wand with a blue gemstone core, crisp silver accents, and the calm clarity of scholarly magic.

name: Ruby Wand
description: It is a warm, commanding wand set with a red gem, glowing as if it holds a heartbeat of ember fire.

name: Mana Wand
description: It is a focused channeling wand of luminous craft, sleek and disciplined, designed to shape raw power with precision.

name: Astral Wand
description: It is a celestial wand of radiant crystal and star-born ornament, elegant and distant, like magic drawn from the night sky.

name: Woodcutter's Axe
description: It is a practical felling axe forged from plain iron, with a broad workman's head, worn edge, and the sturdy humility of a tool made for the frontier.

name: Forester's Axe
description: It is a balanced forest axe with a clean steel blade, modest brass fittings, and the disciplined grace of a woodsman's trusted companion.

name: Ranger's Axe
description: It is a lean and agile axe with a refined edge, dark haft, and a quiet wilderness elegance suited to a hunter of wild places.

name: Warden's Axe
description: It is a stern guardian's axe with a reinforced blade, iron trim, and a severe, watchful silhouette of authority.

name: Timberlord's Axe
description: It is a lordly chopping axe with polished steel, tasteful ornament, and the unmistakable bearing of command over deep woods.

name: Ancient Grove Axe
description: It is an elder relic of steel and root, marked with sacred carvings and a venerable forest aura, as if the grove itself had armed it.

name: Crude Stone Axe
description: It is a rough-edged stone axe lashed to a simple wooden haft, primitive and blunt, with the raw honesty of the first weapons.

name: Oak Stone Axe
description: It is a sturdier stone axe with an oak shaft, warm wood grain, and a more deliberate shape rooted in old craftsmanship.

name: Ash Stone Axe
description: It is a lighter stone axe with a pale ash handle, cleaner lines, and a quick, practical form for hard travel.

name: Cedar Stone Axe
description: It is a reddish cedar-hafted stone axe with neat bindings and a rustic, warmly finished presence.

name: Ebony Stone Axe
description: It is a dark and severe stone axe with a blackened haft and an ominous, ritual-like elegance.

name: Worldroot Stone Axe
description: It is a root-bound stone axe of living fibers and ancient bark, wild and sacred, as though grown from the earth itself.

name: Miner's Pickaxe
description: It is a rugged pickaxe with a stout, functional head that comes in earthy copper, polished bronze, sturdy iron, or as a gleaming enchanted tool with silver-etched runes, filigreed gold inlays, or a cosmic star metal head that glows softly, each mounted on a worn hardwood handle.

name: Prospector's Pickaxe
description: It is a slender, sharply pointed pickaxe featuring a lightweight head crafted in weathered copper, refined bronze, toughened steel, or inlaid with arcane silver glyphs, dazzling gold highlights, or shimmering star metal veins, all fixed to a narrow, grip-wrapped wooden shaft.

name: Quarrier's Pickaxe
description: It is a broad, wedge-headed tool for splitting stone, forged in rustic copper, deep-hued bronze, solid iron, or meticulously etched with mystical symbols in silver, luxurious gold decorations, or swirling cosmic motifs in radiant star metal, with a reinforced, rugged handle.

name: Deep Delver's Pickaxe
description: It is a long, curved-headed pickaxe with an extended piercing tip, available as aged copper, dark bronze, forged steel, or with luminescent silver enchantments, delicate golden filigree, or otherworldly star metal inscribed with ancient runes, all with a grip suited for deep cavern explorations.

name: Stonebreaker's Pickaxe
description: It is a heavy, hammer-backed pickaxe with a brutally jagged head made of beaten copper, ornate bronze, toughened iron, or inscribed with crackling runes in enchanted silver, majestic gold, or glowing star metal, attached to an extra-thick and deeply grooved wooden handle.

name: Mountain King's Pickaxe
description: It is an awe-inspiring ceremonial pickaxe with an oversized, ornate head in primitive copper, boldly engraved bronze, regal steel, or magnificently adorned with runic silver, gem-set gold, or luminous star metal that shimmers with celestial patterns, mounted on an ancient, heroic haft.
